cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Back me up when I explain that I cover mornings. The manager keeps confusing cover with permanent availability.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wasn't at the meeting where you agreed your hours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm not asking you to quote minutes. Confirm that mornings are a sensible use of my skills.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't tell him you had an agreement if I didn't hear it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then don't. When I say 'morning cover,' nod at that phrase. Please leave the history to me; you can endorse the scheduling.

reason: Use professional distinctions to narrow the backing request after B knowledge boundary, keeping A desired ordinary shift version central.
